title: What we will make in this React module
summary: Preview of the module: several small React practice apps plus the main Keeper project, and the React and ES6 topics that will be covered along the way.

concepts.heading: Projects in the module
points: Small apps: a registration screen, a real-time clock, an emoji dictionary and a to-do list.
Main project: Keeper, a clone of Google Keep where the user adds notes for new ideas.

concepts.heading: React topics ahead
points: JSX, components, props, containers, the virtual DOM, state management, declarative programming and hooks such as useState.

concepts.heading: ES6 (ES2015) topics ahead
points: Destructuring, the spread operator, map and filter, and import/export modules; the module doubles as a deeper JavaScript lesson.

playground.coverage: No playground lesson yet (no data file exists for section 36)
gaps_and_ideas: (Extra) Consider a React section roadmap page in the playground listing these topics in order, linking to each future lesson.
